next_question: Can a unit-free, power-calibrated certification test decide whether a given statistic actually reads its treatment, on a substrate where the treatment is a genuine randomized assignment rather than a covariate, and can it do so on the three exact Codex estimators imported by sha256 plus a matched non-constant blind pair used as preregistered power cases? Concretely, a NEW experiment under a new director_mandate (this freeze is spent and must not be re-run or repaired in place): (1) INTERVENTION, NOT COVARIATE. The server must assign the treatment by an explicit randomized policy whose assignment-to-outcome information I(assignment; next_state | state, regime) is computed and preregistered BEFORE freeze, with the planted effect shown to exceed the decision threshold at the declared sample size, and the treatment must not equal any stratum key. Today's substrate cannot support the claim being tested: latent_state_before == state_before in 2200/2200 rows, state_after = (state_before + action_idx + 1) mod 8 in 1137/1137 deterministic rows, and 0 randomized assignments exist, so the 'channel' is a relabeling of the current state. (2) A CRITERION A CALIBRATED ESTIMATOR CAN PASS. Delete delta_statistic >= channel_MI_c, which compares a quantity in the estimator's own units against a quantity in bits and is unsatisfiable: for any calibrated estimator of I(R;Y|C) the displacement equals MI_c - E_null[I], with E_null[I] = 0.1780420209486134 bits on this data, a 0.1780-bit margin that requires over-scaling by at least 1.1005x (0.99x, 0.90x and 0.50x all REJECT). The replacement must be dimensionless and must not compare across units: acceptance by a preregistered within-stratum dynamic-range check on the estimator's own output, plus a displacement measured against the SAME estimator evaluated on a matched-null re-draw of the treatment (an independent within-stratum relabel of the true assignment), with the minimum detectable displacement derived from a power calculation computed BEFORE the criterion is frozen and expressed in the estimator's own units, and the p-value computed from draws that do not also define the reference distribution. (3) A BATTERY WITH NO CONSTANTS. Every known-bad case must be the hash-pinned Codex artifact, imported and hash-verified, not a re-implementation (research/experiments/EXP-PHYSICS-36279239922/execute_calibration_v3.py sha256 19e44d27bc6b089a3a5297396c1bb97887cf6f65c74cf211a4555ab6570bc0e4 for the conditional-entropy statistic); the Product comparator and the Frontier endpoint must be the preregistered non-constant computations treatment_cost/cold_cost and goal_state_success = all(steps.expected_code AND final_store_empty), which the audit's probe shows the displacement leg already catches (delta 0.0 and 1.11e-16, p 1.0); and a structurally non-constant null must be added, a statistic with non-zero within-stratum range and zero target information, because today's 4-of-9 constants left G3 almost information-free. Drop the frozen G2 form 'min_permutation_p < 0.01 on all known-bad': for any constant statistic p = (1 + 1000)/(1000 + 1) = 1.0 identically, and the attainable resolution floor is 1/1001 = 0.000999000999000999, so the metric conflated the floor with a per-estimator p-value. (4) THE POSITIVE CONTROL MUST BE THE ESTIMATOR UNDER TEST: the Runtime header-only Jaccard discrimination statistic of EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580 executed on stored real HTTP response headers, not estimators.py:171-204's I(treatment; target | regime, action) with no Jaccard code anywhere in the packet - and that VALIDATED designation needs its own adjudication first, because codex/claim_state.json records a sibling Runtime packet reproducing the same summary statistics (mean 0.4643, nullFP 0.0, same_state_J 1.0) as hardcoded. (5) THE HTTP EVIDENCE MUST BE STORED AND CONSUMED: today's client observations are discarded after collection, ground_truth_log.jsonl carries no method, headers, body or status, 0 HTTP responses reach any estimator, and the frozen alignment_verified criterion is therefore unrecoverable post hoc, so the new packet must persist full request/response pairs and report an alignment number. (6) THE CONTROLS MUST BE ABLE TO FAIL: a fresh per-case RNG with recorded seeds (today one shared default_rng(44) makes PC and KG, the same callable on the same data and channel, differ at 1.7711598936776587 versus 1.771066334482052), a hash of evaluate.__code__.co_code, and a static check that no code path branches on the estimator id (today run_experiment.py:245-249 selects the channel by estimator id while the comment above it claims all channels are tested, and all 9 results carry one identical code_path_hash). Falsifier for that cycle: any calibrated estimator of the planted assignment-to-outcome MI is REJECTed, or any preregistered non-constant blind statistic is ACCEPTed, or the pre-freeze power calculation cannot be met at the declared sample size - in which case the answer is UNKNOWN and no certification gate is established. Do not repeat: the frozen criterion; the within-stratum-permutation invariance leg on a substrate where the treatment is its own stratum key; a 1-of-4-channel execution presented as a channel ladder (CH-PARTIAL-0.5 at 0.6250 and CH-PARTIAL-0.1 at 0.1964 were computed and never used, and 0.1964 lies inside the 0.1658-0.2061-bit null-channel bias, so the ladder is not resolvable at this sample size); a positive control that wraps the known-good; a null control that duplicates a baseline; and constants as known-bad cases. If the Global Research Director declines a second certification cycle, the physics fallback is a materially orthogonal measurable object from the C-WEB-DYNAMICS registry next_gate (effect factorization, barriers, timescales, geometry, multiscale dynamics), and per this verdict it must not be measured with the statistic class tested here.
why_next: This packet answers nothing about the mandate and invalidates one instrument, so the next question is a redesign at the level of the decision rule and the substrate rather than a rerun. Five considerations drive it. First, the frozen acceptance test could not have accepted anything. It requires delta = |stat_test - E_null| to reach channel_MI while delta is in the estimator's own units and channel_MI is in bits, so for any calibrated estimator of the channel's conditional MI the displacement is MI_c minus a strictly positive null expectation. The Director re-derived this from the producer's own numbers: stat_test = 1.9491083554306654 = IVC_CHANNEL_MI_CH-IDENTITY exactly, delta = 1.771066334482052, E_null = 0.1780420209486134, margin 0.1780 bits, required over-scaling 1.1005x, and the audit's independent scale probes at 0.99, 0.90 and 0.50 all REJECT. A criterion that only a miscalibrated estimator can pass is not a certification gate, and it means the 9/9 REJECT carries no information about the nine statistics. Second, the invariance half of the same contract is empty on this substrate: strata are keyed by (regime_before, state_before, action) and the treatment equals state_before in 2200/2200 ground-truth rows, so within-stratum permutation of the treatment is the identity, and the frozen bitwise criterion was implemented as np.isclose. The contract therefore demanded insensitivity and sensitivity to the same variable simultaneously. Third, the mandate's own battery was never run: two of the three named Codex estimators were hardcoded 'return 1.0', the third was a fresh re-implementation although the hash-pinned artifact exists in this worktree at the digest prereg 5.1 cites, the positive control was a one-line wrapper around the known-good with no Jaccard code anywhere, and 4 of 9 slots were constant functions, so the one gate that passed, G3, was carried by constants whose p is 1.0 by construction. Fourth, there was no intervention to be valid with respect to: the treatment is a covariate, state_after is a deterministic function of (state_before, action) in the deterministic regime, and 0 HTTP responses reached any estimator, so the packet measured a covariate's information content under relabeling on a substrate whose HTTP layer no measured quantity touched. Fifth, and the reason the next question stays in the certification basin rather than moving to a new physics object, the parent handoff already established that the non-Markovian relaxation-time object must not be measured with an uncertified statistic, and the Global Research Director's own portfolio assessment split the program-wide measurement problem with the estimator side assigned to physics. Re-entering a new measurable object with the statistic class invalidated here would repeat the parent packet's trap under a new name. But the route forward must not be a retune either: the new question changes the level of description on three axes at once (a genuine randomized assignment instead of a covariate; a dimensionless criterion referenced to the estimator's own matched-null re-draw instead of a cross-unit comparison; a hash-pinned non-constant battery with a pre-freeze power calculation instead of constants), and it carries its own falsifier, including the honest UNKNOWN branch if the planted effect cannot clear the threshold at attainable sample size. What the next agent must not do is spend another cycle re-running, retuning or renaming this frozen contract, and must not read this packet as evidence that instrument certification is infeasible.

PRECEDENCE RULING (answers audit unresolved[0] / U1). The packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not FALSIFIES. Governing artifacts: prereg.md section 8 'Gate Evaluation Order: G5, G6, G7 (infrastructure) -> G1, G2 (contract validity) -> G3, G4 (scientific outcome)' plus the prereg gate table mapping G2-DISPLACEMENT-POWER failure to MEASUREMENT_INVALID ('contract's null lacks power') and G6-GROUND-TRUTH failure to MEASUREMENT_INVALID ('substrate failure'), plus spec.json decision_rule.outcome_mapping routing 'null_power_NOT_demonstrated OR substrate_failure OR code_path_violated' to MEASUREMENT_INVALID. The frozen acceptance criterion delta_statistic >= channel_MI_c is unsatisfiable by any calibrated estimator of the channel's conditional MI on this substrate, by the Director's own arithmetic on the producer's reported numbers: stat_test = IVC_CHANNEL_MI_CH-IDENTITY = 1.9491083554306654 (the estimator returned the channel MI exactly, i.e. it was perfectly calibrated), IVC_DELTA_STATISTIC_KG-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD = 1.771066334482052, so E_null = 1.9491083554306654 - 1.771066334482052 = 0.1780420209486134 > 0 and delta < MI_c by a 0.1780-bit margin. Passing requires over-scaling the statistic by at least 1.1005x. The audit's independent recomputation agrees (AUDIT_E_NULL_BITS 0.1782223538506356, AUDIT_ACCEPT_THRESHOLD_MARGIN_BITS 0.17822235385063556, AUDIT_REQUIRED_ESTIMATOR_OVERSCALING_TO_PASS 1.1006, AUDIT_KG_SCALED_0.99 / 0.90 / 0.50 verdicts all REJECT, AUDIT_ACCEPT_BRANCH_REACHABLE_FOR_CALIBRATED_ESTIMATOR false). The criterion lives at intervention_validity_contract.py:209 as passed = (delta >= pre_registered_mi - 1e-10) and (p_value < 0.01), where delta is in the estimator's units and pre_registered_mi is in bits. Consequence: the 9/9 REJECT is a property of the criterion, and the criterion selects for miscalibration.

The frozen metamorphic-invariance leg has zero power on this substrate and was not implemented as preregistered. Strata are keyed by (regime_before, state_before, action) (intervention_validity_contract.py:62-72) and the treatment is latent_state_before, which the Director re-verified equals state_before in 2200/2200 rows of ground_truth_log.jsonl, so within-stratum permutation of the treatment is the identity and the audit's recomputation finds 0 of 80 strata change their (T,Y) multiset. The frozen criterion was bitwise equality (spec.json measurement_validity[0]; prereg 4.2 step 6); the implementation is np.isclose with default rtol=1e-5 at line 145. The single invariance failure, B-SHUFFLED-CHANNEL, is a pooled-Pearson-versus-bits units artifact (delta 0.005685912713440204, p 0.6723276723276723), not a validity signal.

The two acceptance conditions are antagonistic in kind: ACCEPT requires the statistic to be insensitive to within-stratum permutation of the treatment and sensitive to a channel re-draw of that same treatment. On a substrate where the first is the identity, the observed pattern of 8/9 invariance passes with 0/9 displacements is what such a contract must produce, and neither the producer nor the frozen design discloses the conflict (audit V3).

The contract as frozen and executed is a degenerate always-REJECT device on this battery. 6/6 expected-REJECT cases and 0/3 expected-ACCEPT cases were classified REJECT; 4 of 9 slots are constant functions (KB-PRODUCT-COLD and KB-FRONTIER-GOAL return 1.0; B-NULL-INSTRUMENT and NC-CONSTANT-ZERO are the same 'return 0.0' function); PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD is 'return kg_runtime_header_jaccard(data)'; the auditor counts 5 distinct estimator behaviours across 9 slots. G3 therefore carries almost no discriminating content.

rejected: The producer's disposition that this packet FALSIFIED the certification hypothesis (result.json status=COMPLETE outcome=FALSIFIES, report.md 'Decision Rule Application: ANY known-good REJECT -> FALSIFIES'). Bounded rejection: the accept branch was arithmetically unreachable before execution, so the trigger condition carries no diagnostic content, and the frozen decision mapping routes the same facts to MEASUREMENT_INVALID. This is a rejection of the INFERENCE, not of any number; the numbers stand.

The frozen acceptance criterion delta_statistic >= channel_MI_c as a usable classifier. Bounded: unsatisfiable for any calibrated estimator (margin 0.1780 bits, required over-scaling 1.1005x) because it compares a quantity in the estimator's own units against a quantity in bits, so it selects for miscalibration. It says nothing whatever about whether an estimator reads its treatment, and it is NOT a demonstration that no acceptance criterion can work.

The frozen G2-DISPLACEMENT-POWER gate as written, 'min_permutation_p < 0.01 on ALL known-bad estimators'. Bounded: for any constant statistic all 1,000 permutation draws equal the observed value, so perm_deltas are all 0, n_exceed = 1000 and p = 1001/1001 = 1.0 identically, making the gate unsatisfiable for a battery containing constants; and prereg 4.3's 'minimum attainable permutation p' conflates the test's resolution floor (1/1001 = 0.000999000999000999) with a per-estimator p-value, which is what the metric name IVC_MIN_PERMUTATION_P_[ESTIMATOR_ID] encodes. Under the floor reading the packet's own observation 'Null power demonstrated (p<0.01): False' is a misreading of its own metric (audit RF12, U3). Neither reading makes the gate informative about contract power.

G5-IDENTICAL-PATH as executed. Bounded: a tautological control (one hashed digest stamped on every result) that cannot fail, while the exact estimator-specific branching it was designed to detect is present at run_experiment.py:245-249. prereg 4.4 required evaluate.__code__.co_code, not evaluate's source text.

G7-NO-EXTERNAL-DEPS as executed. Bounded: two literal True assignments with no check, printed unconditionally as PASS. The underlying substance (no credential, no container registry, no browser) does hold and is credited; the flag is not evidence.

G6-GROUND-TRUTH as reported false. Bounded: the log is complete at 2200 = 200 x 11 contiguous steps; the failure signal is an off-by-one in the checker's expected count. Note separately that the frozen measurement_validity[3] criterion also required alignment_verified == True, no alignment_verified metric exists anywhere in result.json.metrics, and because the client-side observations were discarded rather than stored the required alignment is not recoverable from this packet at all (audit U5).

The metamorphic-invariance result as a validity measurement. Bounded: a tautology on this substrate (treatment equals its own stratum key, 0 of 80 strata change under within-stratum permutation), and the one failure is a units artifact rather than a contract signal. The criterion is not thereby shown to be wrong in general - only that it was not tested here.

The report.md validity_notes claims 'Known-bad estimators replicate exact failure modes from Codex evidence' and 'Known-good estimator replicates validated Runtime header-only Jaccard'. Bounded: both are false as written. Two known-bad cases are hardcoded 'return 1.0', the third is a re-implementation rather than the hash-pinned artifact, and the known-good computes a conditional MI in bits with no Jaccard computation anywhere in the packet (the header helpers at estimators.py:240-285 have 0 call sites).

B-IDENTITY-CHANNEL and B-SHUFFLED-CHANNEL as the preregistered channel baselines. Bounded: spec.json baselines and prereg section 7 define them as treatment CHANNELS, but both are implemented and reported as estimators (|Pearson r| between treatment and target, estimators.py:297-318). B-IDENTITY-CHANNEL's REJECT is therefore a mis-specified case, and its value (delta 0.10844878700231303) is a correlation coefficient compared against a channel MI in bits. Their REJECT verdicts carry no information about the contract's ability to accept maximum signal.

That the preregistered channel ladder was tested. Bounded: 2 of 4 channels were evaluated, selected by estimator id rather than by design, and the packet contains no evidence about the CH-PARTIAL ladder at all.

That this packet tested the three Codex estimators named in the mandate. Bounded: it did not, in any of the three cases. Any statement that the IVC 'certifies' or 'detects' the Physics conditional-entropy statistic, the Product fixed-request cold comparator or the Frontier goal-state-success endpoint is unsupported.

That the certification meta-hypothesis is falsified, that a reusable pre-registered estimator-certification contract is infeasible, or that instrument certification has no general solution. Bounded: the frozen criterion could not express its accept branch, so this run contains no test of the hypothesis in either direction (audit claim_ceiling item (a)). Per AGENTS.md physics discipline this bounded failure invalidates one instrument; it does not close C-MEAS-VALID, the certification question, or the Physics domain.

That the contract has a false positive on a validated estimator. Bounded: the positive control was not the preregistered estimator, the one informative case was perfectly calibrated and failed only because of the threshold defect, and no Codex-validated estimator was executed in any form. The G4 false-positive branch was never actually evaluated (audit U7).
unknown: Whether the displacement leg has power against a NON-CONSTANT blind estimator at the treatment-label/target distinction, demonstrated preregistered. The auditor's two probes were encouraging (both REJECTed at delta ~ 0) but were constructed post hoc and the producer ran no such case. This is the power question the mandate actually posed and it remains open (audit U2).

Whether the preregistered four-level channel ladder could separate anything. CH-PARTIAL-0.5 at 0.6250223459567555 and CH-PARTIAL-0.1 at 0.19637327051861805 were computed and never evaluated, and 0.1964 lies inside the 0.1658-0.2061-bit null-channel bias the auditor measured, so the ladder is not resolvable at this sample size even if it had been run (audit U4).

The alignment between client-observed and server-logged transitions, which spec.json measurement_validity[3] requires and prereg 4.5 requires recomputed independently. Because the client-side observations were discarded rather than stored, this is permanently unrecoverable from this packet and is not a question any future stage can answer from these artifacts (audit U5).

The relationship between the recorded ground truth and real HTTP semantics. The server serves the state the client requested in the response body while logging a transition derived from server-side session state, so served representation and logged transition can diverge; nothing in the packet measures or bounds that divergence, and the packet's own header-level reasoning was never executed against a real response (audit U6).

Whether the Codex-recorded Runtime header-only Jaccard estimator, the preregistered positive control, would be ACCEPTED or REJECTED by a corrected contract. It was never executed in any form here, so the question is untested in both directions. Its own VALIDATED designation also needs adjudication before reuse: codex/index.json records EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580 as audit_status PASS 'DISTRIBUTED VALIDATED canonical shared-WAL real-cache gate on plain HTTP localhost', but codex/claim_state.json describes a sibling Runtime packet reproducing the same summary statistics (mean 0.4643, nullFP 0.0, same_state_J 1.0) as hardcoded, and the packet directory is absent from this worktree (accepted copy at codex/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580) (audit V12, U7).

Whether end-to-end determinism of any single case can be achieved for this contract. The server is single-threaded with fixed seeds, but the contract's numerics are RNG-order dependent, so no case-level number is independently reproducible as executed (audit U8).

How much of the 0.1780420209486134-bit null expectation is finite-sample plug-in bias and how much is real structure. It matters directly for any replacement criterion's threshold, and it was not decomposed.

Whether a dimensionless acceptance criterion referenced to the estimator's own matched-null re-draw can be both satisfiable by a calibrated estimator and able to reject a non-constant label-reading statistic. This is the core open design question the next experiment must answer, and it is unanswered here.

Whether any Web-dynamical structure beyond memory and similarity is measurable on an intervention-valid substrate. Not measured here, not measured in the parent packet, and not measurable with the statistic class tested here.
do_not_assume: Do not assume the certification meta-hypothesis is falsified, that instrument certification is infeasible, or that the program has no general solution to instrument-blindness. The frozen criterion could not express its accept branch, so this packet contains no test of the hypothesis. Per AGENTS.md physics discipline a bounded instrument failure does not close the C-MEAS-VALID domain or the Physics domain, and the registry next_gate is untouched.

Do not assume the contract falsely rejects a validated estimator, and do not cite KG-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD or PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD as evidence of a contract false positive. KG returned exactly the channel MI (a perfectly calibrated estimator) and was REJECT because delta = MI_c - E_null falls short of the threshold; PC is a one-line wrapper around KG and differs only by shared-RNG call order.

Do not assume the 9/9 REJECT is evidence about the nine statistics. Four of nine were constant functions, five distinct behaviours existed across nine slots, and 4 of the 6 expected-REJECT passes came from constants whose permutation p is 1.0 by construction. Rejecting a constant is not the documented failure mode and carries no information about estimator blindness.
